info.description: This collection contains all API endpoints for the Travels application, covering authentication, vendor onboarding, package management, user bookings, payments, and admin operations. It is designed to support end-to-end API testing across different roles such as User, Vendor, and Admin. The collection includes secured routes, environment-based configuration, and request samples to validate request flows, business logic, and integrations like OTP authentication and payment processing. This collection is used for local development, testing, and validation before deployment to staging or production environments.

item.description: Contains all authentication and session-related APIs for the application. These endpoints handle OTP-based login, social logins (Google, Facebook, Apple), user verification, token generation, session validation, and logout. All secured APIs across the system depend on the access tokens generated by these endpoints.
